info.title: Workspace Global Public API
info.description: Independent Global management authority. Key and Global Token issuance are available. Regional data and refresh endpoints are served by Region directly. All expiry values use Unix seconds. Credentials must never be logged or stored in URLs.

default.description: Structured denial or unknown outcome; no credential is echoed.

post.description: Exchange the Workspace Key at Global only. Region audience requests require matching applied regional policy. Without clientThumbprint the response is a short-lived Region access Token. With an Ed25519 client JWK thumbprint it also includes a client-bound enrollment ticket for direct regional refresh enrollment.

default.description: Structured denial or unknown outcome; no credential is echoed.
Structured denial or unknown outcome; no credential is echoed.

get.description: Requires resources:read on a current Global Token. Only the Key-granted Region is returned. Data requests go directly to Region.

post.summary: Exchange a Workspace Key without configuring a Workspace or Region
post.description: The Key identifies its Workspace. Use audience global or region; region selects the Key-granted Region. Legacy Keys without a Workspace hint continue to use the Workspace-scoped issuance endpoint. Never forward the Workspace Key to a Region.

default.description: Successful response

get.summary: Discover the Region through a bodyless redirect
get.description: Send only a Global access Token. Inspect the redirect without automatic credential forwarding; validate the HTTPS target against authenticated Global discovery before using the Region Token. Do not send SQL or file content to this endpoint.

patch.description: Extends expiry while retaining the Key secret, advances Key version and invalidates old Global Tokens. Regional application is reported separately. Only an explicit same-secret renewal durably observed by both authorities before the previous expiry enables existing proof-bound families to cross versions. An unreachable Region remains pending; unavailable continuity requires fresh enrollment.
